package.name: openarm_servo
package.description: moveit_servo real-time Cartesian/joint jogging for the OpenArm bimanual robot - one servo_node per arm. Separate from openarm_moveit_config (which owns the offline OMPL/Pilz/CHOMP/STOMP planning pipelines) since this is a different, always-a-second-process-alongside-bringup use case, not another planning pipeline option.
